moments.title: Halloween arrives!
moments.blurb: The spooky season culminates tomorrow, October 31st, with Halloween celebrations across the UK for families and adults alike.

angles.name: Trick or Treat
angles.copy: Tomorrow's the day for ghosts, ghouls, and way too much candy! What are your Halloween plans?

angles.name: Spooky Night In
angles.copy: If trick-or-treating isn't your bag, what's your go-to scary movie or Halloween playlist for a spooky night in?

moments.title: Grace Slick is 87
moments.blurb: Legendary Jefferson Airplane and Jefferson Starship vocalist Grace Slick celebrates her 87th birthday today, October 30, 2026.

angles.name: White Rabbit Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the incredible Grace Slick! Her voice defined an era with classics like 'White Rabbit' and 'Somebody to Love'. Still sounds as powerful today.

angles.name: Psychedelic Pioneer
angles.copy: Grace Slick, the iconic frontwoman of Jefferson Airplane, turns 87! A true pioneer of psychedelic rock and a voice that commanded attention.

moments.title: Duran Duran at The O2
moments.blurb: New Wave legends Duran Duran play a Halloween show at London's O2 Arena tomorrow, October 31st.

angles.name: Halloween Treat
angles.copy: Feeling Hungry Like The Wolf? Duran Duran are at The O2 tomorrow for a special Halloween gig! Who's going to be there?

angles.name: 80s Icons Live
angles.copy: Duran Duran bringing the New Wave magic to London's O2 Arena tomorrow night. Get ready for some iconic hits!

moments.title: Premier League: Liverpool vs Arsenal
moments.blurb: A huge Premier League clash sees Liverpool host Arsenal at Anfield on Sunday, November 1st, kicking off at 4:30 PM.

angles.name: Top Flight Battle
angles.copy: Sunday afternoon means a massive Premier League showdown! Liverpool take on Arsenal at Anfield. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Title Race Impact
angles.copy: This weekend's biggest fixture: Liverpool vs Arsenal. Huge implications for the title race. What's your score prediction?

moments.title: Anthony Kiedis turns 64
moments.blurb: Red Hot Chili Peppers frontman Anthony Kiedis celebrates his 64th birthday on Sunday, November 1, 2026.

angles.name: RHCP Legend
angles.copy: Happy 64th Birthday to the iconic Anthony Kiedis! The voice of the Red Hot Chili Peppers, still bringing the funk and energy.

angles.name: Funk Rock Frontman
angles.copy: From 'Under the Bridge' to 'Californication', Anthony Kiedis has fronted RHCP for decades. Wishing him a very happy 64th today!

moments.title: Mags Furuholmen is 64
moments.blurb: Magne Furuholmen, keyboardist and songwriter for Norwegian synth-pop band A-ha, turns 64 on Sunday, November 1, 2026.

angles.name: A-ha's Keys
angles.copy: Take On Me! A big 64th birthday shout-out to Magne Furuholmen, the talented keyboardist and songwriter from A-ha.

angles.name: Synth-Pop Master
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 64th to Magne Furuholmen of A-ha! His synth-pop magic created some of the 80s' most memorable tunes.

moments.title: Nelly turns 52
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper, singer, and entrepreneur Nelly celebrates his 52nd birthday on Monday, November 2, 2026.

angles.name: Hot In Herre
angles.copy: It's Nelly's 52nd birthday! From 'Hot In Herre' to 'Dilemma', he dominated the charts. What's your favourite Nelly track?

angles.name: Hip Hop Star
angles.copy: Happy 52nd to the one and only Nelly! Still got those St. Louis vibes and classic hits.

moments.title: k.d. lang is 65
moments.blurb: Acclaimed Canadian singer-songwriter k.d. lang celebrates her 65th birthday on Monday, November 2, 2026.

angles.name: Powerhouse Vocalist
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to the incredible k.d. lang! A voice like no other, captivating audiences for decades.

angles.name: Canadian Icon
angles.copy: From 'Constant Craving' to her stunning interpretations, k.d. lang is a true musical icon. Happy 65th birthday!

moments.title: Adam Ant turns 72
moments.blurb: New Wave icon Adam Ant, born Stuart Leslie Goddard, celebrates his 72nd birthday on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

angles.name: Prince Charming
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the dandy highwayman himself, Adam Ant! Still 'Stand and Deliver'-ing style and sound.

angles.name: New Wave King
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 72nd to Adam Ant! A true original who defined the New Wave era with his unique flair.

moments.title: Stevie Wonder at The O2
moments.blurb: Music legend Stevie Wonder brings his 'Songs In The Key of Life' 50th Anniversary Tour to London's O2 Arena on November 3rd and 5th.

angles.name: Living Legend
angles.copy: An absolute icon is in London this week! Stevie Wonder performing 'Songs In The Key of Life' at The O2. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: Timeless Album
angles.copy: Stevie Wonder celebrating 50 years of 'Songs In The Key of Life' at The O2 on Nov 3 & 5. A truly unmissable experience.

moments.title: Korn at The O2
moments.blurb: Nu-metal pioneers Korn will play London's O2 Arena on Wednesday, November 4th, with special guests Architects and Youth Code.

angles.name: Nu-Metal Icons
angles.copy: Korn are bringing the heavy to The O2 on Wednesday! Ready for a night of nu-metal classics?

angles.name: Gig Alert
angles.copy: If you're a rock fan, London's O2 is the place to be on Nov 4th as Korn hit the stage!

moments.title: Bonfire Night approaches
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night, also known as Bonfire Night, is celebrated annually on November 5th, with many firework displays happening around the UK on the closest weekend (Nov 7-8).

angles.name: Remember, Remember
angles.copy: Get ready for the crackle and pop! Bonfire Night is next Thursday, November 5th. What are your plans for the 'Glorious Fifth'?

angles.name: Fireworks Fun
angles.copy: Fireworks displays will light up skies across the UK next week for Bonfire Night. Safety first, but what a spectacle!

moments.title: Bryan Adams is 67
moments.blurb: Canadian rock icon Bryan Adams, known for hits like 'Summer of '69' and '(Everything I Do) I Do It for You', celebrates his 67th birthday on Thursday, November 5, 2026.

angles.name: Summer of '69 Forever
angles.copy: Happy 67th Birthday to the legendary Bryan Adams! What's your favourite Bryan Adams power ballad or rock anthem?

angles.name: Rock Star Photographer
angles.copy: Bryan Adams turns 67! A true multi-talent, from selling millions of records to his acclaimed photography work.

moments.title: Art Garfunkel turns 85
moments.blurb: Half of the iconic folk-rock duo Simon & Garfunkel, Art Garfunkel, celebrates his 85th birthday on Thursday, November 5, 2026.

angles.name: Bridge Over Troubled Water
angles.copy: Happy 85th Birthday to the legendary Art Garfunkel! That voice is truly unmistakable. What's your favourite Simon & Garfunkel track?

angles.name: Folk-Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a wonderful 85th to Art Garfunkel, whose harmonies with Paul Simon created some of music's most enduring songs.

moments.title: Suede & Manic Street Preachers Live
moments.blurb: Two giants of British alternative rock, Suede and Manic Street Preachers, co-headline a show at London's O2 Arena on Friday, November 6th.

angles.name: Britrock Legends
angles.copy: Suede AND Manic Street Preachers on one bill at The O2 this Friday? That's a double dose of Britrock brilliance! Who's excited?

angles.name: Live Rock
angles.copy: Get ready for an epic night of anthems as Manic Street Preachers and Suede hit London's O2 this Friday!

moments.title: Autumn Nations: Ireland vs Argentina
moments.blurb: Ireland's Autumn Nations Championship campaign begins as they host Argentina at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin on Friday, November 6th.

angles.name: Emerald Isle Kick-off
angles.copy: The Autumn Nations Championship kicks off for Ireland this Friday as they face Argentina in Dublin! Big game for the boys in green.

angles.name: Pumas Challenge
angles.copy: Ireland vs Argentina in the Autumn Nations on Friday night! Can the Pumas cause an upset?

moments.title: Autumn Nations: Wales vs Japan
moments.blurb: Wales kick off their Autumn Nations Championship with a home fixture against Japan at Principality Stadium, Cardiff on Saturday, November 7th.

angles.name: Cymru Kicks Off
angles.copy: Huge weekend for Welsh rugby! Wales face Japan in the Autumn Nations Championship at Principality Stadium this Saturday. Come on Cymru!

angles.name: Brave Blossoms in Cardiff
angles.copy: Wales vs Japan this Saturday in Cardiff! Always an exciting fixture against the Brave Blossoms. Who's heading to the Principality?

moments.title: Lorde turns 30
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning New Zealand singer-songwriter Lorde celebrates her 30th birthday on Saturday, November 7, 2026.

angles.name: Royals @ 30
angles.copy: Can you believe Lorde is turning 30 this Saturday? The 'Royals' singer has had an incredible career already! Happy Birthday!

angles.name: Musical Visionary
angles.copy: Happy 30th Birthday to Lorde! A truly unique artist who continues to push boundaries with her music.

moments.title: Joni Mitchell is 83
moments.blurb: Influential Canadian singer-songwriter Joni Mitchell celebrates her 83rd birthday on Saturday, November 7, 2026.

angles.name: Big Yellow Taxi Legend
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the incomparable Joni Mitchell! A true poet and musician whose work continues to inspire.

angles.name: Folk Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd to Joni Mitchell, a visionary artist whose songwriting changed music forever.

moments.title: Autumn Nations: England vs Australia
moments.blurb: England begin their Autumn Nations Championship campaign against Australia at Twickenham Stadium on Sunday, November 8th.

angles.name: Twickenham Clash
angles.copy: England vs Australia at Twickenham this Sunday! The Autumn Nations Championship is officially underway for the Red Rose. Who's watching?

angles.name: Wallabies Challenge
angles.copy: Huge game this Sunday as England take on the Wallabies in the Autumn Nations. Get ready for some fierce rugby action!

moments.title: Bonnie Raitt turns 77
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning blues-rock singer-songwriter and guitarist Bonnie Raitt celebrates her 77th birthday on Sunday, November 8, 2026.

angles.name: Blues-Rock Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Bonnie Raitt! A true legend of blues-rock guitar and soulful vocals.

angles.name: Slide Guitar Master
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 77th to Bonnie Raitt! Her distinctive slide guitar and powerful voice have earned her legions of fans.

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: The 26th series of I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! is set to begin on ITV on Monday, November 16th, hosted by Ant & Dec.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out Of Here! returns to ITV on November 16th. Who are you hoping to see in the jungle?

angles.name: Bushtucker Trials
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are back! Get ready for the return of I'm A Celeb next month. Who do you think will face the first Bushtucker Trial?
